key_idea: NPF(i) = d(i) - omega(i): number of divisors minus number of distinct primes, both precomputable with a linear sieve.
sketch: Run a linear sieve up to 2e6 tracking the smallest prime factor, its exponent, the divisor count d and distinct-prime count omega (multiplicative updates: same smallest prime bumps the exponent, a new prime doubles d and increments omega). Each query is then one table lookup. Total O(MAX + Q). The only real difficulty is I/O with 3e6 queries: read the whole input with fread and build the output in one buffer.
